changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM WORK_QUEUE_WORKER_GROUP WHERE QUEUE_ID IN ( SELECT q.ID FROM WORK_QUEUE q WHERE q.CODE = 'HOLDING' AND q.QUEUE_KIND = 'HOLDING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QUEUE_ENTRY e WHERE e.QUEUE_ID = q.ID) );
DELETE FROM WORK_QUEUE WHERE CODE = 'HOLDING' AND QUEUE_KIND = 'HOLDING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QUEUE_ENTRY e WHERE e.QUEUE_ID = WORK_QUEUE.ID);
